label: preparing
what: Likely a coordinated bread-based hospitality gathering in the great hall at eighteen o'clock. Baker, freight and innkeeper were coordinating a bread order; baker asked builder how many loaves reached the hall and about grain funding. Secretary knowingly arranges my attendance and escort, though there is no evidence secretary knows any undisclosed purpose. I was told of the hospitality meeting but not the full preparations or purpose; a surprise specifically for me remains uncertain.
